Name: Nude Valley - Unofficial 1.6 update
Author: sumaniBlack
Description:
[size=4]This is an unofficial update for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10616]Nude Valley [/url]mod from simezi21 who okayed updates for their mods - if you like this go over there and endorse it.[/size]
[size=4][b]This mod will be available until simezi21 either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/b][/size]

This update is only necessary if you want the ability to disable portraits or single villagers. If you are happy with the original Nude Valley you don't need this.

Almost all NPC sprites and portraits will be changed to nude, and male NPCs will be feminized.
This mod is based on Jcdr's Oppai Valley and is not compatible with other styles.
From the Generic Mod Config Menu, Futanari and glasses display can be configured. It's also possible to disable single villagers or only use the sprites, if you want to use other portraits.
You can set all villagers to either portrait or completely off. This will override any individual configuration you have, so doing something like Abigail On and All Villagers Off will result in Abigail not having any changes.
You can deactivate all non-villagers if you like. There will not be individual switches for them.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1.Download and extract this mod and the Required Mod.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.
